identifier_uniqueness_over_whole_run._why_this_matters: Consults NO golden, so it is as strong as the run is large. The paper's collision-free identifier claim is measured over tens of standards at the _only_subset tier; this measures it over 214.

⚠️_precision_not_reported: grade_parser measures coverage and per-field accuracy over matched pairs. A golden of 26 against a run of 214 says nothing about the other 188. Coverage is NOT precision.
